resources.string: License and privacy
Privacy policy and data deletion
We use an installation ID and a digest of the Android ID to manage activation and the trial period. We do not use your phone number or IMEI. Read the privacy policy for data and deletion details.

Save a recovery key outside this device before uninstalling. It transfers your paid license only; playlists and passwords are not imported automatically.

Delete my data and revoke activation

This revokes this device and its recovery key and deletes its playlists, cloud profiles, diagnostics and local app data. A minimal anti-abuse record and required transaction records remain. Your account with your content provider is not deleted. This cannot be undone.
